provenance.excerpt: Arcane Intention is an Arcane Enhancement that increases maximum health for every active channeled ability. Effect Rank Max Health Bonus 0 +40 1 +80 2 +120 3 +160 4 +200 5 +250 Acquisition May appear as a Steel Path Circuit Tier 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, or +11 reward on a weekly rotational basis. May be sold by Acrithis for 10 Pathos Clamp on a daily rotational basis, requiring Drifter Intrinsics Opportunity Rank 9 for the arcanes to appear in her shop. One of possible rewards from completing the optional Undercroft Portals in Duviri while on the Steel Path. Notes The bonus stacks for every channeled ability simultaneously active, up to a maximum of 4 stacks (+1000 Health at max rank). Besides increasing maximum health, activating this Arcane also heals the Warframe by the same amount of hitpoints. After the ability that sustained this Arcane's effect ends, there is a 1 second delay during which said ability cannot be reactivated. Eligible Abilities Only the following abilities can trigger this effect: Warframe Ability Notes Atlas Tectonics Does not qualify if Tectonic Fracture is used. Rumblers Banshee Sound Quake Does not qualify if Resonating Quake is used. Baruuk Elude Serene Storm Chroma Spectral Scream Effigy Cyte-09 Neutralize Dante Noctua Ember Immolation Equinox Pacify & Provoke Mend & Maim Excalibur Exalted Blade Gara Mass Vitrify Only qualifies during the glass wall expansion. Gauss Mach Rush Kinetic Plating Redline Grendel Pulverize Gyre Arcsphere Only qualifies while the gyratory sphere is in motion, not once it is deployed. Coil Horizon Only qualifies while the gyratory sphere is in motion, not once it is deployed. Helminth-transferable Hildryn Balefire Pillage Only qualifies during the initial expansion Helminth-transferable Haven Aegis Storm Inaros Sandstorm Ivara Quiver Only qualifies while its arrows are in flight. Using Artemis Bow's alt-fire to loose Quiver's arrows does not qualify. Helminth-transferable Navigator Only qualifies while actively controlling a projectile. Prowl Briefly becoming visible while Prowl is active does not disqualify it. Artemis Bow Jade Glory on High Lavos Vial Rush Helminth-transferable Limbo Stasis Cataclysm Mag Magnetize Only the protective hold-cast version qualifies Mesa Ballistic Battery Peacemaker Mirage Prism Nekros Desecrate Nezha Divine Spears Nidus Larva Buff is lost on recasting, even if Larva grabs enemies. Helminth-transferable Parasitic Link Nyx Mind Control Helminth-transferable Absorb Oberon Hallowed Ground Only qualifies when Hallowed Eruption is used. Renewal Oraxia Silken Stride Qorvex Crucible Blast Only qualifies during the casting animation. Revenant Reave Helminth-transferable Danse Macabre Rhino Iron Skin Only qualifies when Iron Shrapnel is used. Sevagoth Gloom Helminth-transferable Temple Exalted Solo Titania Razorwing Valkyr Hysteria Wisp Wil-O-Wisp Only qualifies when tap-cast. Sol Gate Wukong Cloud Walker Defy Helminth-transferable Primal Fury Yareli Merulina Riptide Only qualifies when tap-cast. Helminth Parasitic Armor Tips Many Warframes lack channeled abilities altogether, making it impossible to use this Arcane with them. Certain abilities can be transferred via Helminth to circumvent this: Gloom can be infused onto any Warframe in order to give them a channeled ability and enable the use of this Arcane. Mind Control and Parasitic Armor are abilities with high base duration that can maintain this Arcane's effect without constant energy drain. Pillage, Coil Horizon and Quiver are also Helminth-compatible and can make use of this Arcane's secondary effect of instant healing upon ability activation. Patch History Hotfix 33.0.11 (2023-05-24) Fixed rare crash that would occur when viewing Arcane Intention while in the Arsenal. Update 33.0 (2023-04-26) Introduced.
